description: Source-derived obligation inventory only. Existing pack bindings do not assert execution, platform/backend qualification or completeness of every semantic branch. Exemptions remain open work. Native LiteRT-LM catalog 10 S01 records capability admission only; the maintained litert-lm-json-schema local scenario supplies bounded CPU enforcement evidence. Wider schema/platform pack qualification remains https://github.com/leehack/llamadart/issues/174.

packs.notes: Web negative-mainGpu routing and unsupported GPU paths are covered by test/unit/backends/webgpu/webgpu_backend_test.dart; native CPU-placement rejection is covered by test/unit/core/engine/engine_test.dart. These model-free controls do not qualify WebGPU hardware or the separate NPU work in https://github.com/leehack/llamadart/issues/915.

Catalog 13 binds raw top-K and candidate scores, prompt-prefix reuse equivalence and argument guards on CPU Stories15M, plus typed unsupported rejection for LiteRT-LM. A mapping is not qualification of other models, platforms or WebGPU, and reuse equivalence does not prove the cache was used.

Catalog 11 binds the public KV persistence obligation. CPU Stories15M is the initial diagnostic profile; pack mapping is not qualification of another model, platform, sampler/RNG checkpoint or arbitrary cross-model rejection.

exemption.reason: This pre-load desktop report has no model/backend probe and cannot qualify native loading or inference. VM production-path tests cover host publication selectors, bounded package version origin, privacy and actual CLI JSON/argument behavior; common model and unsupported Web paths run in Chrome. A versioned diagnostics pack remains separate from model capability validation (#861) and cross-platform qualification (#1196).

The history pack does not assert template clock semantics. Production-path VM and Chrome tests cover real strftime_now rendering, request snapshots, context trimming, structured output, tool loops and compatibility with existing ChatSession implementations and application extensions. Runtime-owned LiteRT-LM templates retain their runtime clock. A versioned clock scenario remains tracked separately.

The local-only native-reranking scenario compares full classifier outputs and server output zero against exact pinned upstream for named-template two-class Qwen3 and single-output fallback Jina/BGE, with batching, overflow, cancellation and lifecycle controls. Deterministic tests cover framing, optional-backend rejection, bounded classifier-directory verification, explicit RANK loading and buffer lifetime. A versioned cross-platform validation pack remains separate; local receipts do not qualify other platforms or model families.

The shared embeddings pack exercises raw engine vectors, not explicit text profiles. Deterministic production-path tests cover raw defaults, prefixes, batching/fallback and invalid outputs; the local-only text-embedding-retrieval scenario compares every EG2 output dimension with the pinned official float32 CPU model. A versioned cross-platform profile pack remains separate; no GPU, media or quantized qualification is implied.

Reliable runtime termination and automatic-loop rollback, including native LiteRT-LM finish reasons, need their own validation contract; the litert-lm-chat-features-smoke local check covers the LiteRT-LM cutoff. Ordinary best-effort tool-call cases are insufficient.

Administrative/configuration, compatibility or diagnostic surface has existing unit/integration coverage but no dedicated feature-pack contract. Native LiteRT-LM backendName after the ComputeDevice.auto CPU retry of a failed GPU engine (#1034) is covered by service and worker integration tests, not device runs. Inventory is not a claim of model/device qualification.

Dedicated image profiles and device evidence exist, but reported image capability fields are not yet bound to versioned validation feature/case IDs. This is a coverage-map gap, not a new runtime support claim. ImageConditioningCacheParams.capacity has maintained engine/worker tests and image-generation-smoke qualification on SDXS/SD-Turbo CPU and Metal; it has no versioned validation-pack case yet. SeamlessImageGenerationRequest circularX/circularY has maintained API/ABI refusal tests and image-seamless-textures CPU/Metal quality and cancellation qualification for SDXS; versioned pack case IDs remain open in https://github.com/leehack/llamadart/issues/1234. TiledImageGenerationRequest has maintained request/legacy-interface, engine/worker/ABI guards and image-generation-smoke SD-Turbo full-VAE/TAESD CPU/Metal qualification; it has no versioned validation-pack case yet (https://github.com/leehack/llamadart/issues/1231). FP8 weights load on Metal with the pinned stable-diffusion-native v0.3.0-1, which converts them to F16, decided by StableDiffusionCalls.loadsFp8AsF16OnMetal; engine/worker/probe tests cover both that path and the refusal on a runtime without the fix, and local-only SD-Turbo FP8 re-encodings generate on macOS arm64 CPU and Metal. A versioned FP8 validation-pack case remains open in https://github.com/leehack/llamadart/issues/1446. Approximation caching remains https://github.com/leehack/llamadart/issues/1233.
Runtime adapter loading, scaling, removal and unsupported/version-skew paths need a dedicated LoRA pack.

Chat image/audio and projector lifecycle need a dedicated multimodal-chat pack. Embedding media packs are a separate contract. Public API VM/Chrome regressions cover early typed refusal of tool-role image/audio and valid separate user-media routing (#1445); they do not qualify model media transport or tool-result media support (#1008).

Thinking-output cases do not establish sampler-control or thinking-budget semantics. Native LiteRT-LM penalties and thinking budgets are qualified by a local-only real-model test (test/e2e/backends/litert_lm_generation_controls_e2e_test.dart); dedicated positive/unsupported/runtime-skew pack coverage remains.
Draft/MTP/ngram strategies need a dedicated pack with target/draft output and memory controls; ordinary text generation is insufficient.

Dedicated speech profiles/runners exist, but their reported capability fields are not yet bound to versioned validation feature/case IDs. The web-speech-task-cancel local E2E separately covers direct/worker task isolation and bounded reuse with explicit TTS batch 512/micro-batch 256 (#1371); it does not bind these capability fields or qualify every speech flag or negative path.

Catalog 11 state cases do not report the identity yet; a versioned state-pack case follows catalog 12. Default CI covers the native report, digest fields, unsupported and pre-v0.7.0-3 runtimes, and a cross-process save, identity match, load and resume against fresh evaluation on the CPU test model. It does not qualify other models, devices or a matching identity as exact resumed output (#1003).
Video is unsupported by the public runtime paths. Preserve typed rejection; no compatible video model/validation pack is claimed.

The existing C06.history pack covers native GGUF profiles, not the new LiteRT-LM Web preface/system path. Production-path Chrome tests cover ordered text, old/missing APIs, typed rejection and reset/cancellation isolation; the maintained litert-lm-web-text-history local runner compares a pinned JS reference and preface-bypass controls on an identified browser/model. A dedicated versioned Web validation profile and broader tool/media/template parity remain open in #1152. No model qualification is inferred from these inventory bindings.

The bounded local complete SD-Turbo F16/F32 Safetensors set recipe has maintained path/identity/header/cache/cancellation/refusal tests and a native-reference directory/index CPU qualification scenario. A dedicated versioned validation-pack profile remains open in #1219. This inventory binding does not qualify generic Diffusers layouts, other tensor profiles, platforms or image-editing/tiling/seamless combinations.

Owned RGB/binary-mask requests have maintained API validation, engine/worker/ABI refusal and lifetime tests plus the image-editing macOS CPU SD-Turbo full-VAE direct-C qualification scenario. Versioned image-editing pack/profile cases remain open in #1221; inventory presence is not platform/model qualification.

Load-time SD 1.x ControlNet admission, owned control input, worker probe/failure detection and native mapping have maintained unit tests plus the local-only image-controlnet macOS CPU direct-C scenario; real SD 1.5 plus canny ControlNet qualification passed on macOS CPU (doc/image_controlnet.md); a versioned validation-pack profile remains open in #1224. Inventory presence is not platform/model qualification.

Hires-fix limits, load-time recipe admission, session probe, two-pass progress, output-size check and sd_hires_params_t mapping have maintained unit and worker tests plus the local-only image-hires-fix macOS CPU/Metal direct-C scenario (doc/image_hires_fix.md); a versioned validation-pack profile is not yet defined. Inventory presence is not platform/model qualification.
